text:
F-w7wh (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 54): SOURCE-ASSISTED READING. A research reader reread every line of both strips on canvas 0 at native resolution (bands of about ten lines per strip, plus full-width bands), and revised some readings with the 1561 print of Herman/Mathesius, Haußhaltung (bsb10203350, scans 11-15) in view. A second research reader reread the lower right strip, the abraded foot of the left strip and section 1 before opening the print at those places (after seeing the first reader's tentative readings), then collated them. Lines below are those relied on. L = left strip (x about 2540-3520), R = right strip (x about 4280-5250); left line n continues on right line n+1. [..] loss, ( ) expansion, ? uncertain. Canvas 0 = Stams_STA_Frg_054_01r, 7360 x 4912.

SECTION 1 (Psalm 128 paraphrase; L box 2540,560-3520,1820; R box 4280,560-5250,1820)
L display: [..] du frumer Christ
R display: [..] Feder fris[ch]
L: [..]ll, auf diser Erden [..]
L: Vnd soll auf seinen we[gen]
L: [..] allzeit. Allain durch d[..]
L: [..]rt. sein beschert, dein W[eib]
L: Vnd deine kinder vmb de[n tisch]
R: [..]gesunt vnd frisch
R: [..] der Ewig Got
R: [himl]isch Jherusalem,
L: [..]glid, Vber Israel den [..]
R: [..]er frumer Christ
L (box 2540,1580-3520,1820): Amen (display), then in small script: denn es war[..]
